text_block_list.text:
What greeted the pitch-black victor who 
conquered the year-end Grand Prix was—a 
thunderous roar of applause.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everything I encountered on my journey to 
this place—the expected, the unexpected, 
all of it—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I truly appreciate 
it...!

Upon her deeply bowed head, the applause 
rained down without end—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Why are you trying to end things on a 
wholesome note? Golshi-chan isn't having 
any fun here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, when're you running next, 
Flash-y-pants~? You ain't just gonna take 
your win and run... are ya?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Of course I'm not going to run 
away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Komm jetzt, Gold Ship-san. —I will gladly 
stand as your wall anytime."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the real challenge begins here. 
We can't just bask in our victory forever.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After all, this is the very first time 
I've ever greeted a tomorrow with nothing 
planned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, my directive going forward 
is "do entirely as I please". It is an 
exceptionally difficult situation.
choice_data_list: Well, do you want to pass on it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because it is difficult 
that planning a schedule is worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—What should we decide on first? I'm so 
excited, Trainer!”
